basics.name: Dmitry Rybalka
basics.label: Lead Product Designer
basics.summary: Product design leader with 15+ years of hands-on UX/UI and product design experience since January 2011. Leads Product Design, UX Research, DesignOps, and Design Systems at Larixon Classifieds. Experience spans FinTech, marketplaces, classifieds, HealthTech, leasing, e-commerce, travel, gaming, and automotive services. Open to remote work or relocation.

work.name: Larixon Classifieds
work.summary: International classifieds group with market-leading platforms across Cyprus, Mongolia, Tajikistan, Trinidad and Tobago, and Jamaica. Project markets include Cyprus, Mongolia, Tajikistan, Trinidad and Tobago, and Jamaica.
highlights: Developed the design function across Product Design, DesignOps, Design Systems, and UX Research.
Led a team of 7 Product Designers and 1 UX Research Lead across 8+ product verticals.
Built the Design System from 0 to 1 for Web and App, including DSO roles, governance, and a maturity tracker.
Launched UX Research from 0 to 1 across Cyprus, Mongolia, and Tajikistan, including cross-country studies.
Defined design strategy, linking design initiatives to business goals.
Established OKR-based DesignOps, design reviews, Jira visibility, onboarding, and individual development plans (IDPs).
Introduced AI-assisted workflows for discovery, ideation, documentation, and automation.

work.name: Raiffeisen Bank Russia
work.summary: Trading and investment products at the Russian bank, part of Raiffeisen Bank International Group. Product work included a professional terminal serving 500+ institutional clients.
highlights: Led UX for a professional trading terminal serving 500+ institutional clients.
Defined product design strategy across 5+ tools, aligning business goals with user needs.
Mentored 5 designers, conducted design reviews, and supported hiring across 2 product teams.
Used LLM-powered tools to accelerate research preparation, synthesize insights, and explore early hypotheses.

work.name: Raiffeisen Leasing
work.summary: B2B leasing marketplace and internal CRM workflows for sales teams, business clients, and dealers.
highlights: Designed a B2B leasing marketplace and modular CRM for 19 role types and 350+ sales representatives.
Cut offer generation time from 12 to 2 minutes by redesigning quoting workflows and UI logic.
Increased process automation from 10% to 90% by streamlining business rules and operational flows.
Contributed to defining and implementing the Triple Diamond design process for an organization of 40+ designers.

work.name: Yandex.Market
work.summary: Large-scale e-commerce marketplace work across analytics products, seller-facing tools, vendor onboarding workflows, and product taxonomy.
highlights: Led UX for a large-scale analytics platform used by product and category teams.
Reduced vendor onboarding time from 90 days to 1 day by redesigning agreement workflows.
Designed seller tools for 35,000 marketplace vendors.
Improved product taxonomy and categorization for 57M SKUs covering 890 marketplace categories.

work.name: GdeMaterial
work.summary: Early-stage DIY marketplace for construction and home improvement materials.
highlights: Led UX for a DIY marketplace startup with 500+ suppliers and 2K B2B clients.
Built and launched mtrl.pro, a B2B platform for construction and wholesale clients.
Increased conversion from 0.5% to 1.6% through product page and checkout redesign.
Launched purchase and logistics workflows, including real-time communication between suppliers and buyers.

work.name: Medesk Ltd.
work.summary: B2B HealthTech SaaS platform used by healthcare providers across 35 countries.
highlights: Designed UX for a healthcare platform used by 1000 clinics across 35 countries.
Launched an online treatment flow for 10K B2C patients.
Improved NPS from 37 to 54.
Integrated 10 third-party modules and 5 medical laboratories.
Designed and developed the design system using Storybook-based UI components.

work.name: Budilkin.ru
work.summary: Marketplace for premium watches and accessories, including desktop and mobile experiences and B2B tools for retail stores.
highlights: Launched a marketplace from scratch with more than 54,000 watch SKUs and over 173 brands.
Designed a B2B system for more than 200 offline stores and 10 online shops.
Developed and launched a high-conversion email marketing strategy.
Increased browsing depth from 3 to 6.

work.name: Blamper
work.summary: Social network for car owners and a service for solving automotive technical problems.
highlights: Designed product interfaces for the pre-seed fundraising stage; the round raised $400K.
Created landing pages with an 18% visit-to-registration conversion rate.

work.name: Mental Games
work.summary: Developer and publisher of multiplayer online games.
highlights: Created interfaces for a unified user account serving 50,000 gamers across six online games.
Designed a gaming community website.

work.name: LightSoft Research
work.summary: Travel products including TopHotels.ru, HotelsPassport.ru, and TourPoisk.ru, with hotel information and tools for travel agents.
highlights: Designed interfaces for 318,000 hotel profiles.
Launched and maintained interfaces for a travel agent platform.

references.name: Alim Uderbekov
references.reference:
If you’re considering about working with Dima, I hope this review will help you to get the right answer.

Dima is a not just a great designer, he is a great thinker. Within our job, he showed many times that before do something we need to clearly understand the customer journey, that design is not about just beauty, it’s about usability. 

So if you want to get the things done and you’re doing something valuable, Dima for sure will help you to make it understandable and usable.

I’m strongly recommend him as a product designer and I’ll definitely hope to work with Dima someday again!

references.name: Ilya Sergeev
references.reference:
I worked with Dima at Raiffeisen Bank. Dima proved himself as a high-level specialist.

He successfully demonstrated a wide range of capabilities: from developing existing products to launching new services from scratch. He offered fresh conceptual design solutions and scalable approaches. Dima always focused on business goals while deeply immersing himself in user problems.

Dima always looked beyond his product group: he helped adjacent teams, established a unified design process, and implemented activities to improve design literacy. He initiated process shifts within the team to achieve results more effectively.

He led the design group. With his help, the quality of designers' solutions improved, and a mature approach to tasks was formed. Designers began to interact more effectively with product teams. He also actively participated in recruiting specialists for the design team, which helped us fill strong senior-level positions.

I confidently recommend Dima as an excellent specialist who will deeply immerse himself in your business, help your team make a breakthrough, and take design to a new level in your organization.

references.name: Victor Antonov
references.reference: I can recommend Dmitry as a thoughtful designer who is deeply involved not only in the process of interface design but also in the core essence of the product and business.

references.name: Alexey Filatov
references.reference: We hired Dmitry as Senior UX/UI designer in Raiffeisen bank for a very complicated role. Dmitry was responsible for the whole design infrastructure of Leasing product: ERP system and onnline-services. Dmitry has recommended himself as a very innovative person, who always tries to improve research, design and implementation processes. Dmitry has conducted dozens of interviews and UX-tests and shared the results with the SCRUM team. I have worked with many designers and I want to mention that Dmitry is almost the only one who tries to deep into the business processes, financial model, stakeholders view and other business aspects of the product. Last but not least, Dmitry tries to build the workflow and personal communication in the direction when you feel confidently and transparent with him like he is co-founder of your startup.

references.name: Ilia Zinchenko
references.reference: We've worked with Dima on the service Yandex.Market Analytics. He did a great job and designed a lot of useful decisions. It was very efficient and comfortable to work with him.

references.name: Maria Nosyreva
references.reference: I worked with Dmitry at Raiffeisen Leasing. Dmitry is a professional designer with high standards of performance. He always keeps user in mind while proposing new design. Dmitry has great experience in different products that he uses to develop the best possible solution. Dmitry is an open person who shares his knowledge and he seeks ways to improve and learn. I can recommend him confidently as a team worker and experienced goal-orienteered designer.
references.relationship: Worked with Dmitry on the same team

references.name: Paaez Coleman
references.reference: Dmitry is diligent and insightful! Among his many qualities, he employs a thorough research process to ensure he creates stunning pages that cater to the user experience. He’s a very talented designer and marketer and I would definitely work with him again!

references.name: Egor Fleishman
references.reference:
I’ve worked with Dmitry as a senior UX/UI designer and lead designer on projects (UX/UI research, watch marketplace, Hotel booking System, Analytics for suppliers and partners, and other online services) in such companies as LightSoft, Budilkin, Fteam for 7 years. In all projects Dmitry was responsible for the UX/UI interface. Dmitry is a well-structured, high-performance, motivated expert in UX/UI. He always strives to solve product tasks as efficiently as possible using a data driven approach and accessible analytics. In working together all the tasks were solved. 

I am sure that Dmitry's experience will be invaluable for any product-oriented companies or teams.

references.name: Oleg Makushev
references.reference:
I had the pleasure of working with Dmitry at Medesk, and he quickly impressed me with his strong product thinking, design system expertise, and calm, structured approach to solving problems. His design work consistently balanced usability, scalability, and aesthetics — making it easier for engineers like me to implement clean, user-friendly interfaces.

Dmitry was always open to feedback, actively collaborated across teams, and brought a clear vision to the table. He’s a thoughtful, reliable teammate who cares deeply about building not just great designs but great products. Working with him was inspiring and truly efficient.
references.relationship: Worked with Dmitry on the same team

references.name: Julia Di
references.reference:
I had the pleasure of working with Dmitry Rybalka, who is one of the strongest managers I’ve had in my career — across design, sales, and customer support.

Dmitry consistently demonstrates a strong ability to identify growth opportunities, assess current challenges, and develop effective, well-thought-out solutions. His work is grounded in strategic thinking, solid technical understanding, and a clear analytical approach.

He is a reliable and well-organized professional who manages his work with discipline and attention to detail. At the same time, he actively listens to different perspectives and adapts his approach to support each team member.

Dmitry’s soft skills are a real strength — he creates a comfortable environment where challenges can be discussed openly, and solutions are found without unnecessary pressure.

I’m confident that any team would benefit from having Dmitry as a manager.

I’m personally grateful for the time we worked together — it was a valuable experience, and I learned a lot from him.

references.name: Ekaterina Popova
references.reference:
Working with Dima was genuinely one of the most comfortable and positive professional experiences I’ve had. From the very beginning, communication was always clear, structured, and respectful, which created a strong sense of trust and stability in everyday work.

I always understood the goals, priorities, and next steps, and that clarity made collaboration incredibly smooth and motivating. What I appreciated most was the quality of feedback — it was always thoughtful, constructive, and delivered in a way that helped me grow while still feeling supported.

Beyond being a strong professional, Dima creates an environment where people feel heard, trusted, and comfortable asking questions or sharing ideas. That combination of organization, calm leadership, and human approach made a huge difference in the overall experience of working together!

I’m truly grateful for the opportunity to have worked with Dima!!

During the course of our projects, Dmitry was professional, friendly, straightforward, laser-focused on the goal and extremely efficient in reaching them. Dmitry's work ethics is impeccable, he is excellent communicator; Dmitry is a great team player who is equally efficient when working independetly.

references.name: Anton Illarionov
references.reference:
When Dmitry joined us as a Design Manager, the company was growing fast, and we desperately needed better processes. He took on the messy job of structuring how we worked, and the results were great.

He brought much-needed clarity by defining specific roles and setting strict rules for task inputs and design outputs. Instead of just managing people, he restructured the whole team into product verticals, which made scaling a lot smoother.

What I really respected was his practical approach to the business side of design. Dmitry analyzed our workflow to find exactly where we were losing money or time, and fixed those gaps. He was also the one pushing the team to adopt new AI tools to speed up our daily routine.

Dmitry is a smart, process-driven manager who knows how to make a design department actually efficient. I’d gladly work with him again.

references.name: Bogdan Mavrin
references.reference:
I had the pleasure of working with Dmitry at Larixon, where he was my Design Manager on the Jobs vertical. He's easily one of the best managers I've had in my career.

Dmitry has a strong understanding of business and product context, and he always helped me see the bigger picture behind what we were doing. His approach to managing the team was grounded in clear thinking and practical solutions, which made a real difference in how we worked. He also consistently encouraged the team to explore new tools, including AI, which helped streamline our processes and work faster.

Beyond the professional side, Dmitry is simply a great person to work with. He built a team environment where designers felt supported and could discuss challenges openly without unnecessary pressure. I'm confident that any design team would benefit from having Dmitry as a leader. I'm grateful for the experience of working with him, and I would gladly do it again.
